notes: The welcome tour is re-recorded in today's LATYS, with a new chapter on building with a team in Workflows. Local voice works out of the box again: the bundled Parakeet voice engine was missing from installers since v0.1.65. Agent cards are more accurate: a message you send to all your agents shows as each agent's task, a finished result no longer hides new work, a new agent reads Starting… then Ready, resizing a card no longer brings back old activity, and the launch command no longer flashes on a new card.
